title: Feelings diary
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Common vocabulary: personal pronouns, my family, adjectives and moods
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: feelings diary)
intro: Lesson 21: Feelings with reasons: لِأَنَّ. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Say: I am worried because I have an exam.

panels.title: Calm in worry
points: 'Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest' (13:28)

questions.q: Say: I am happy because my grandmother is visiting (تَزُورُنَا).
Feelings diary in the portal response box: five sentences about this week, each with a feeling and لِأَنَّ. Start: 'يَوْمَ الإِثْنَيْنِ كُنْتُ ...' or 'أَنَا ... لِأَنَّ ...'
questions.a: Five correct sentences with feelings and reasons

questions.q: Extend: add a sentence with لٰكِنْ (but).
questions.a: For example: أَنَا مُتْعَبٌ لٰكِنْ سَعِيدٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: translate 13:28's key phrase: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ القُلُوبُ.
questions.a: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

questions.q: Think again: does knowing why help?
questions.a: Yes: you can act, make du'a or ask for help.
